meta.title: Azalia Flower Shop
meta.description: Azalia is a flower shop: delicate signature bouquets, custom bouquets and personalised ribbons.

hero.subtitle: Every bouquet is a small story about tenderness, love and beauty. We gather it from fresh flowers especially for someone dear to you.
hero.imageAlt: A lush bouquet of garden roses in cream, powder-pink and lavender shades
hero.insetAlt: White and pink peonies in close-up

welcome.title: A place where flowers become emotions
welcome.text: Azalia is a place where flowers become emotions. We create delicate bouquets that speak of love, care and the most sincere feelings.
welcome.imageAlt: A raspberry-pink peony in a glass vase beside a book and a cup

fresh.title: Fresh flowers
fresh.text: We select every flower with care so your bouquet brings joy for as long as possible.

author.title: Signature bouquets
author.text: We combine shades and textures so that each bouquet is one of a kind.

care.title: Attention to detail
care.text: Wrapping, ribbon and card — we think everything through to the final touch.

about.title: We love flowers — and it shows in every bouquet
about.lead: Azalia grew out of a simple love of flowers. To us a bouquet is not a product but a way to say what matters most without words, so we arrange every composition by hand and with heart.
about.quote: Flowers say what is hard to put into words.

love.title: Love of flowers
love.text: We work with flowers every day and never stop admiring them. That love is where each of our bouquets begins.

individual.title: A personal approach
individual.text: We listen carefully to who the bouquet is for and what the occasion is, then choose flowers, shades and mood just for you.

author.title: Signature bouquets
author.text: We never work from a template: every composition is created by a florist as a small work of art.

quality.title: Quality and freshness
quality.text: We use only fresh flowers and look after them gently so your bouquet keeps its beauty for longer.

care.title: Care for every detail
care.text: From the shape of the bouquet to the ribbon and wrapping — every little thing matters, because the impression is made of them.
